theorems.name: Submission.dohr_vel_graph_projection_trace
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (P Ψ : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (L : Rn n →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (Q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (D : Amb n ℓ →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ), (∀ v : Rn n, L v = graphPoint v (P v)) → (∀ (v : Rn n) (w : Rn ℓ), D (Q.symm (graphPoint v w)) = Q.symm (graphPoint 0 (Ψ v))) → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Amb n ℓ) (D.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (Submodule.map Q.symm.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (LinearMap.range L.toLinearMap)).starProjection.toLinearMap) = ∑ a : Fin n, ∑ c : Fin n, ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (P (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (P (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))⁻¹ a c * inner ℝ (P (EuclideanSpace.single c (1 : ℝ))) (Ψ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ)))
